title: Global AI News Network Atlas
subtitle: Regional co-occurrence networks in AI-related news, 2016–2025
working_paper: Measuring Global AI Cooperation, Competition and Innovation through News Text: A Graph-based Approach
interpretation_note: An edge indicates that two ADM1 regions were mentioned in the same filtered AI-related news document. Co-occurrence is an observational news-text relationship and does not by itself establish direct cooperation or competition.
zero_value_note: All supplied ADM1 units are retained on the map. Regions without observed activity in the selected year are encoded as zero and remain visible and interactive.
map_note: The supplied global ADM1 geometry contained one duplicated region key (Mazandaran, IRN); its two geometries are combined into one displayed ADM1 unit. Three tiny island geometries that collapse below the integer SVG coordinate precision are represented with a minimum visible footprint at their geometry-derived representative location.
